title: Pakistan weighs austerity measures as US-Iran war drives up fuel prices
content: the measures were introduced on march 9 as oil prices surged during the US-Iran war . the steps included halving fuel allowances for official vehicles, reducing lawmakers' salaries and allowing public sector employees to work from home for part of the week . renewed hostilities have once again pushed up global oil prices .

title: Munir fails Mecca test: Why Pak's field marshal is not riding to rescue MBS
content: the mecca Pact is a trilateral defence alliance between Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan aimed at strengthening regional security and collective deterrence . the pact's first real test is exposing how little Riyadh can actually count on Islamabad .

title: Why some bats live 50 years while close relatives survive just 7
content: researchers comparing eight closely related Myotis species found an extraordinary range of lifespans . genome analysis revealed that genes associated with longevity overlapped far more than expected with genes involved in virus interactions and cancer defence . findings do not offer an immediate treatment for human ageing, but give scientists a new way to investigate how some mammals remain healthy for decades .
